clients_service_dates_check.name: clients_service_dates_check
clients_service_dates_check.value: "clients"."service_end_date" is null or "clients"."service_start_date" is null or "clients"."service_end_date" >= "clients"."service_start_date"

employee_evidence_check.name: employee_evidence_check
employee_evidence_check.value: "employee_evidence"."expiry_date" is null or "employee_evidence"."issue_date" is null or "employee_evidence"."expiry_date" >= "employee_evidence"."issue_date"

locations_coordinate_pair_check.name: locations_coordinate_pair_check
locations_coordinate_pair_check.value: ("locations"."latitude" is null and "locations"."longitude" is null) or ("locations"."latitude" between -90 and 90 and "locations"."longitude" between -180 and 180)

operational_notes_archive_fields_check.name: operational_notes_archive_fields_check
operational_notes_archive_fields_check.value: ("operational_notes"."archived_at" is null and "operational_notes"."archived_by_user_id" is null and "operational_notes"."archive_reason" is null) or ("operational_notes"."archived_at" is not null and "operational_notes"."archived_by_user_id" is not null and char_length("operational_notes"."archive_reason") > 0)

projects_dates_check.name: projects_dates_check
projects_dates_check.value: "projects"."end_date" is null or "projects"."start_date" is null or "projects"."end_date" >= "projects"."start_date"

user_credentials_email_check.name: user_credentials_email_check
user_credentials_email_check.value: char_length("user_credentials"."email") between 3 and 254 and "user_credentials"."normalized_email" = lower(btrim("user_credentials"."email")) and position('@' in "user_credentials"."normalized_email") > 1

tickets_content_check.name: tickets_content_check
tickets_content_check.value: ("tickets"."summary" is null or char_length("tickets"."summary") <= 10000) and ("tickets"."planning" is null or char_length("tickets"."planning") <= 10000) and ("tickets"."work_completed" is null or char_length("tickets"."work_completed") <= 10000) and ("tickets"."notes" is null or char_length("tickets"."notes") <= 10000)
